TC-10/S04.title: Real devices: dictation, a dropped connection mid-dictation, phones with a wrong date / time zone
TC-10/S04.detail: Not run on 43c38a4f. (1) and (2) need a real voice into real phones with the live transcription session and Wi-Fi dropped mid-sentence; (3) needs phones (or the Android rig) on a 43c38a4f debug build — the device lane's 10-14 Android rig ran e02167f, and the clock code changed in 43c38a4f (TFA-92592 'a value's day is read on the corrected clock'), so its record cannot be carried over. The web half of (3) is TC-10/S22 (not in this package; B18). The pre-round handling itself is judged in a browser by S01/S02/S05/S12 (both modes).
